pipeline: P4 (§5.3 Bash popup command text overflow)

qa.user_verbatim_complaint: 打开右侧弹窗显示的bash命令超出了弹窗宽度
qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: Removed `flexWrap: 'wrap'` from CommandView.tsx:45 (styles.line) and `flex: 1` from CommandView.tsx:59 (styles.commandText). These two properties were forcing the Text inside the outer ScrollView to resolve to parent width (zero scroll extent). Without them, the Text renders at intrinsic monospace character width, which feeds the outer ScrollView's scroll extent for long commands. Live DOM measurement confirms: a Bash card with command 'wc -l /root/docs/dev/specs/spec-20260423-080000.md && echo "---" && cat /root/docs/dev/specs/spec-20260423-080000.md/views/manifest.json' has text scrollWidth=1146px inside a ScrollView clientWidth=760px inside a card offsetWidth=800px — ScrollView contains the text, no visual bleed.

complaint_element_pointer.how_located: browser_evaluate walked up from long-bash-command Text leaf node to find the ancestor ScrollView (scrollWidth=1146, clientWidth=760, overflowX=auto at index 4 in the chain)

element_screenshots.before_selector: N/A - no before state captured (regression pre-fix)

qa.overall_assessment: PASS. Both inline and sidebar-detail rendering of Bash commands now contain long commands inside a horizontal ScrollView. DOM measurement confirms scrollWidth 1146 > clientWidth 760 inside 800px card — scroll works, nothing bleeds outside the card. Source fix verified: CommandView.tsx:45 styles.line no longer has flexWrap; styles.commandText no longer has flex:1 (only font/size/color/lineHeight remain at lines 53-58).
